data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to display Unity Banner, Interstitial, and Rewarded Video Ads.
data.what_it_does: Integrates the Unity Ads SDK into Flutter applications for Android and iOS. It allows developers to initialize the SDK, manage privacy consent, load ads, and display banner or fullscreen video ads with status callbacks.
use_when: You want to monetize your Flutter mobile application using Unity Ads.
You need to display banner, interstitial, or rewarded video ads.
avoid_when: You prefer using AdMob or another ad network instead of Unity Ads.
strengths: Supports Unity Banner, Rewarded, and Interstitial Video Ads
Provides privacy consent management and server-to-server reward callbacks
Firebase Test Lab support on Android
weaknesses: Requires managing native Unity SDK initialization and placement IDs
Android fullscreen ads may require Manifest adjustments to avoid separate recent apps tasks
data.setup_notes: Requires setting up game IDs from Unity Ads, configuring platform-specific settings, and potentially adjusting Android Manifest task affinities for fullscreen ads.

alternatives.name: google_mobile_ads
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want to display ads through Google AdMob / Google Ad Manager instead of Unity Ads.

alternatives.name: yandex_mobileads
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want to integrate Yandex Mobile Ads SDK instead of Unity Ads.
